# Requirements Review Checklist: First Season Setup and Plan Approval

**Purpose**: Review SPEC-002 requirements for implementation completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability across the domain, API, and mobile journey.
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on the SPEC-002 feature context and the three requested independent reviews.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is activation behavior explicitly defined when a farmer removes every task from a `VALIDATED_TEMPLATE` plan? [Gap, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007–FR-009]
- [x] CHK002 Does the season-creation requirement define the outcome when different idempotency keys request the same field, crop, and sowing/planting date? [Gap, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Are allowed and rejected sowing/planting dates defined consistently with this feature recording an actual planting date, including whether past dates are valid? [Ambiguity, Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Scope Boundary]
- [x] CHK004 Does the contract specify how a client recovers a draft after a create response is lost and the client does not know the returned season ID? [Gap, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK005 Are the client's idempotency-key and original-request retention/replay requirements defined across app restart for uncertain draft creation? [Gap, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-015–FR-016]
- [x] CHK006 Does Bugün specify which local timezone and field/business scope determine “today” when the authorized farmer has fields with differing planning timezones? [Gap, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Are plan-task date constraints relative to the season's sowing/planting date explicitly defined, including the meaning of the “invalid order” edge case? [Gap, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Are empty applicable template versions (published with zero task definitions) distinguished from a template plan emptied by farmer edits, with activation behavior defined? [Gap, Edge Case, research.md §Manual plan activation]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Are activation replay and concurrent activation outcomes specified for same-key and different-key requests, including the response to a losing concurrent request? [Clarity, Coverage, contracts/seasons.openapi.yaml §/seasons/{seasonId}/activate]
- [x] CHK010 Does the requirement state whether task mutation requests against an already active season are rejected and what stable conflict behavior the client receives? [Gap, State Transition, contracts/seasons.openapi.yaml §/seasons/{seasonId}/plan-tasks]
- [x] CHK011 Are active-versus-draft season multiplicity rules for a field and crop cycle explicit without assuming an unapproved uniqueness constraint? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases; data-model.md §Season]
- [ ] CHK012 Are custom crop identity and lifecycle requirements sufficient to determine whether repeated equivalent names reuse, duplicate, or create distinct business-scoped crop records? [Gap, Assumption, data-model.md §Custom Crop]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are zero-task activation rules consistent across manual and template-backed plans after farmers may remove any proposed task? [Consistency, Spec §US2, §US3, FR-007–FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Are past-date wording, local-date preservation, API date validation, and the actual-sowing-date scope consistent across spec, plan, contract, and quickstart? [Conflict, Spec §FR-014, Edge Cases; contracts/seasons.openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK015 Are Bugün date selection rules consistent between the plan's snapshotted planning timezone and the contract's current-local-day response? [Consistency, contracts/seasons.openapi.yaml §/today; plan.md §Design Decisions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can each relevant API failure be mapped to a stable, distinguishable client outcome for invalid input, stale version, idempotency payload mismatch, invalid season state, and authorization failure? [Clarity, contracts/seasons.openapi.yaml §responses]
- [x] CHK017 Are accessibility requirements for the mobile season setup and Bugün journey explicit enough to trace to acceptance criteria, including labels, scalable text, contrast, touch targets, and non-color-only cues? [Coverage, plan.md §Constitution Check (Post-Design)]
- [x] CHK018 Are cloud-shell-verifiable mobile acceptance criteria distinguished from excluded later device/runtime evidence without leaving a required mobile criterion unverifiable? [Clarity, quickstart.md §Cloud Shell Commands]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are draft recovery outcomes specified for leaving review, app restart, network loss during creation, and activation failure when the server may have committed the request? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK020 Are empty-plan behavior, no-task-due-today empty state, and no-applicable-template manual fallback separately specified and testable? [Coverage, Spec §US1, §US3; contracts/seasons.openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK021 Are authorization requirements explicit for every read/mutation, including invalid or revoked membership and privacy-safe treatment of nonexistent versus out-of-scope resources? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012–FR-013]
- [x] CHK022 Are immutable crop/template references and copied task history requirements clear when templates change between draft creation and activation, and after activation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010; data-model.md; quickstart.md §Version/history integrity]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are mobile accessibility and weak-connectivity expectations bounded clearly enough to avoid implying unsupported offline mutation or device testing? [Clarity, Scope Boundary; plan.md; quickstart.md]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Is production validated-template publication clearly treated as a content/release dependency rather than a prerequisite that blocks implementation architecture? [Dependency, Assumption, spec.md §Assumptions; plan.md §Constraints]
- [x] CHK025 Are the deferred pilot crop list and pre-sowing season behavior kept outside implementation acceptance criteria? [Consistency, Scope Boundary; spec.md §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [x] CHK026 Have the material product decisions for template-backed zero-task activation, duplicate same-cycle season creation, past actual planting dates, Bugün timezone scope, and lost-create-response recovery been resolved before task generation? [Blocker, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK027 Have remaining date-order, post-activation mutation, and concurrent activation semantics been either specified or explicitly deemed non-blocking by the product owner? [Blocker, Ambiguity]

## Notes

- Independent review outcome before clarification: blocking ambiguities were identified in CHK001–CHK007, CHK009–CHK010, CHK013–CHK016, CHK019, and CHK026–CHK027. These were resolved in the approved specification and design artifacts before implementation.
- Empty `VALIDATED_TEMPLATE` activation and same field/crop/date requests with different idempotency keys have explicit product decisions in the approved artifacts.
- Production validated-template publication remains a release/content dependency. The exact pilot crop list and pre-sowing planning remain deferred and are not specification blockers for implementation architecture.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.

- Round 3 re-review: 26/27 criteria are satisfied. CHK001–CHK011 and CHK013–CHK027 pass against the clarified spec, plan, data model, contract, and quickstart. CHK012 remains open: custom crops use business-scoped identity, while equivalent farmer-entered display names do not merge identity in this feature. Name-based deduplication remains outside scope.
